items.title: Cellik Android malware builds malicious versions from Google Play apps
items.description: A new Android malware-as-a-service (MaaS) named Cellik is being advertised on underground cybercrime forums offering a robust set of capabilities that include the option to embed it in any app available on the Google Play Store. [...]

items.title: GhostPoster attacks hide malicious JavaScript in Firefox addon logos
items.description: A new campaign dubbed 'GhostPoster' is hiding JavaScript code in the image logo of malicious Firefox extensions counting more than 50,000 downloads, to monitor browser activity and plant a backdoor. [...]

items.title: Amazon disrupts Russian GRU hackers attacking edge network devices

items.title: APT-C-35 Infrastructure Activity Leveraged Using Apache HTTP Response Indicators
items.description: A significant discovery in threat intelligence reveals that APT-C-35, commonly known as DoNot, continues to maintain an active infrastructure footprint across the internet. Security researchers have identified new infrastructure clusters linked to this India-based threat group, which has long been recognized as a state-sponsored actor with espionage capabilities targeting critical regions in…

items.title: Russian Hackers Attacking Network Edge Devices in Western Critical Infrastructure
items.description: A Russian state-sponsored hacking group has been targeting network edge devices in Western critical infrastructure since 2021, with operations intensifying throughout 2025. The campaign, linked to Russia’s Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU) and the notorious Sandworm group, represents a major shift in tactics. Instead of focusing on exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities, the hackers now target…

items.title: LLMs are Accelerating the Ransomware Operations with Functional Tools and RaaS
items.description: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into ransomware operations marks a pivotal shift in the cybercrime landscape, functioning as a potent operational accelerator rather than a fundamental revolution. This technology dramatically lowers barriers to entry, enabling even low-skill actors to assemble functional tools and sophisticated Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) infrastructure.…

items.title: Hackers Can Manipulate Internet-Based Solar Panel Systems to Execute Attacks in Minutes
items.description: A new class of internet-based attacks is turning solar power infrastructure into a high‑risk target, allowing hackers to disrupt energy production in minutes using nothing more than open ports and free tools. items.title: ZDI-CAN-28581: Autodesk
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Rocco Calvi (@TecR0c) with TecSecurity' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-12-16, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-04-15 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
